exposure: maternal complications during pregnancy and labor
cohort: 510 pregnant women at a county referral hospital in Kenya, with 102 initially presenting with complications and follow-up up to 28 days after birth (132 with and 364 without complications at the end of the study).
finding: Newborns of mothers with complications were more likely to have low Apgar scores, low birth weight, prematurity, admission to the newborn unit, complications after 28 days, admission after 28 days, and be born by caesarean section.
mod_finding: Mothers with complications were also more likely to have given birth by caesarean section.
birth_weight: low birth weight (mentioned as an outcome)
